notes.title: Session 1 outline
notes.body:
1. The party reaches the bridge at dusk.
2. [[Mara the Ferrywoman]] warns them about the toll.
3. Fight: Bridge ambush.
4. The letter on the chief's body.

notes.title: Mara the Ferrywoman
notes.body:
Wants: the bridge free again.
Knows: the chief answers to someone in town.

notes.title: A sealed letter
notes.body: Hold the bridge until the new moon. Payment as agreed. — V.

monsters.statblock:
Bridge Troll Chief
Large giant, chaotic evil
Armor Class 15 (natural armor)
Hit Points 84 (8d10 + 40)
Speed 30 ft.
STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA
18 (+4) 13 (+1) 20 (+5) 7 (-2) 9 (-1) 7 (-2)
Skills Perception +2
Senses darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12
Languages Giant
Challenge 5 (1,800 XP)
Regeneration. The chief regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn unless it took acid or fire damage since its last turn.
Actions
Multiattack. The chief makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its club.
Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Club. Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

encounters.name: Bridge ambush
encounters.note:
The goblins hide under the bridge (Stealth 16). The chief joins on round 2.
If the chief drops below half, he flees into the river.
